# discord_application_settings (Resource)

Manages settings on the current Discord application (the app behind the configured bot token). The application is not created or destroyed by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_application_settings" "this" {
  description                       = "My bot does useful things."
  interactions_endpoint_url         = "https://example.com/interactions"
  role_connections_verification_url = "https://example.com/verify"
  tags                              = ["utility", "moderation"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_install_url` (String) Custom authorization (install) URL.
- `description` (String) Application description.
- `interactions_endpoint_url` (String) HTTP interactions endpoint URL.
- `role_connections_verification_url` (String) Role connection verification URL for linked roles.
- `tags` (Set of String) Up to 5 descriptive tags for the application.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The application snowflake ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The current application is always the token's own app; the import ID is ignored.
terraform import discord_application_settings.this self
```
